🚀 Web-ScreenRec | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a simple, accessible, and installation-free way for users to record their screen and audio directly from a web browser.
✨ Key Features: • Cross-platform screen recording without installation • Simultaneous recording of screen, microphone, and desktop audio • One-click conversion to MP4 using FFmpeg
📖 Summary: Web ScreenRec is a lightweight, browser-based screen recording application that requires no installation. It allows users to record their screen, microphone, and desktop audio simultaneously and can convert the recordings to MP4 format using FFmpeg with a single click.
